subject: CloudChannel discovery — next steps & technical deep-dive scheduling
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Helen Park <hpark@cloudchannel.io>, Tom Reeves <tom.reeves@cloudgsi.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-16T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: CloudChannel discovery — recap and proposed next steps

Hi Helen / Tom —

Thanks again for carving out time today. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum: 

Recap (30-minute discovery)
- Primary use case: Marketplace listing + private offering for managed GSI customers (data residency constraints noted).
- Traffic profile: spikes during quarter launches, baseline 150 QPS for embeddings/lookup workflows, occasional large batch indexing windows.
- Key constraints: SOC 2 evidence, VPC/private control plane for sensitive tenants, predictable latency for inference (<150ms p95 for short prompts).

Proposed next steps
1) Technical deep-dive (60–90m) with infra/architecture team — want to show dedicated vs private deployment tradeoffs and preconfigure sample throughput.
2) Share a mutual action plan and onboarding checklist (attached — draft).
3) Confirm initial SLO/commit targets and POC timeline (2–4 weeks).

Can you confirm who from CloudChannel should join the deep-dive (names + roles)? We can run a combined call with our Partner PM (Vanessa) and Solutions Architect (Karthik).

Tentative availability from our side next week: 2026-09-22 AM PST, 2026-09-23 10:00–12:00 PST, or 2026-09-24 13:00–16:00 PST. If none of those work, please propose two slots that fit your calendar.

Attaching: CloudChannel_MutualActionPlan_v1.pdf (draft — editable).

Thanks — looking forward to the next step.

Best,
Priyom Das
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
pri[email protected] | +1 (415) 555-0189

---
Attachment: CloudChannel_MutualActionPlan_v1.pdf (1 page — mutual action plan stub)

Hi Priyom —

Appreciate the clear recap. Confirming interest from CloudChannel — we want to proceed with the technical deep-dive. Proposed attendee list from our side:
- Tom Reeves — Head of Partner Integrations (lead)
- Helen Park — Product Partnerships (me)
- Diego Morales — Lead Platform Engineer (infra)
- Sarah Li — Security & Compliance (SOC 2 questions)

A 90-minute deep-dive would be ideal so we can cover architecture and security. Of your proposed slots, 2026-09-23 10:00–11:30 PST works best for most of the team. If you can lock that, we’ll send calendar invites from our side.

Quick Qs before the call:
1) Any pre-reads or short demos you want us to review?
2) Do you have a standard partner onboarding NDA or should we route via our legal?

We’ll aim to confirm internally and get back by EOD.

Thanks,
Helen
Partnerships | CloudChannel Inc.
[hpark@cloudchannel.io]

Pre-reads and ask list (short):
- Please review the attached mutual action plan (high-level timeline + responsibilities).
- If you have specific regulatory questions (data residency or audit scope) include them in the invite so Sarah Li can prep.
